question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping’s consolidated grip on the Chinese Communist Party, Central Military Commission, and state institutions drives the 95.5% trader consensus against his removal before 2027. Recent personnel appointments, ongoing anti-corruption purges targeting potential rivals, and the absence of any designated successor reinforce expectations that he will pursue a fourth term at the 2027 Party Congress. No public health disclosures, elite defections, or policy reversals have emerged to alter this positioning. Realistic shifts could still arise from an abrupt medical event, severe economic disruption prompting internal pressure, or an unforeseen leadership challenge, though current evidence points to continued dominance through at least the congress.
